question_text: In a barangay, a dispute arises between two neighbors over a property boundary. Before going to court, they are encouraged to settle the matter through the Katarungang Pambarangay. What is the role of the Punong Barangay in this process?

options.text: The Punong Barangay acts as a judge and issues a binding decision.
The Punong Barangay mediates or conciliates between the parties to reach an amicable settlement.
The Punong Barangay refers the case directly to the municipal trial court.
The Punong Barangay appoints a lawyer to represent both parties.
